text:
irene: Quick thread: onboarding sample app is still generating duplicate downstream jobs when folks hammer "replay". We get a cascade: 429s -> clients retry -> duplicate webhooks. Need a robust guidance + SDK parity fix.

sam: Which SDKs and flows? streaming vs sync vs async job creation?

irene: Mostly node sample web UI (sync generate) and a couple of customers using the Go sample. No streaming.

ben: Root causes we've seen: (1) no idempotency key for create-like calls, (2) client retries with no jitter (or linear), (3) gateway fast-fail path sometimes omits Retry-After, and (4) sampleapp fingerprinting collides across tenants.

kai: Agree. Two-pronged fix: SDK defaults to safer backoff + parity helper to attach idempotency header; sampleapp adds UI debounce + session store for recent fingerprints; infra audits retry-after inconsistencies.

irene: For backoff, instead of naive exp or uniform jitter, can we default to decorrelated jitter (aka "Full random jitter")? That tends to avoid sync waves. Proposal: decorrelated jitter algo, maxRetries=5, base=100ms, cap=2500ms. Pseudocode in docs.

sam: Sounds good. Also add an opt-in convenience API: `.withIdempotency(key)` which sets `X-Redwood-Idempotency: <key>`. Make it clear in SDK that streaming responses must not set idempotency.

ben: Important nuance: some clients do optimistic retries on UI reloads — sampleapp should persist last-request metadata server-side or at least store a fingerprint in sessionStorage with TTL 5m. On reload suppress identical payloads and show a toast.

kai: Infra also reported gateway fast-fail returning numeric Retry-After in ms (e.g., 60000) for a subset of fallback hosts. That breaks naive parsing in many SDKs. We should normalize on gateway to always return seconds, but SDKs should defensively parse. Suggest: parse header as int; if > 3600 assume ms and divide by 1000; if value > 86400 treat suspicious and fall back to decorrelated jitter.

irene: Good plan. Also to prevent tenant collisions, idempotency keys should include a short tenant scope. Recommend key format: `tenant:<t>-u:<user>-h:<sha1(prompt)>.r:<nonce?>` where nonce is optional for stronger uniqueness. Show sample generator in Node + Go in the onboarding doc.

sam: Can we include a tiny code snippet for Node and Go? I can draft it. Example Node: ```js
const key = `${tenantId}|${userId}|${sha256(prompt).slice(0,12)}`
client.withIdempotency(key).generate(...)
``` Go analogous.

ben: Testing plan: unit tests for header set/absent on streaming, integration test that fires 100 concurrent identical requests and assert single webhook invocation, and a chaos test where Retry-After alternates ms/s and make sure SDK recovers.

kai: I'll open INF ticket to triage the gateway fast-fail normalization. Also adding metric `retry_after_unit_mismatch` when SDK sees suspicious values and emits telemetry so infra can correlate with hosts.

irene: Timeline: want SDK patches (Node + Go) + sampleapp debounce + docs update into staging by EOD Thursday. Who can pick Node? Go? Docs?

sam: I'll take Node PR. Will implement decorrelated jitter default and `withIdempotency` helper. Add tests for streaming case.

ben: I'll do the sampleapp changes: 400ms debounce on replay, sessionStorage fingerprint TTL=5min, visible toast on suppress. Also update README with snippet for tenant-scoped keys.

kai: Infra-bot 1: please create INF-1400 for gateway normalization + add a quick patch to canonicalize Retry-After units on ingress.

infra-bot: Created INF-1400: gateway normalize Retry-After units & telemetry -> triage.

irene: Awesome. One more UX note: make the sampleapp show a small "pending" state and disable the replay button while a request is inflight. That prevents most accidental double-clicks.

sam: Will do. I'll land a small opt-out flag so customers can keep old behavior if they rely on it.

ben: After staging, let's run a replay-stress smoke test (50 concurrent replays) and watch webhook dedupe metric. If clean, push docs + onboarding note.

irene: Thanks all. This combined approach (SDK parity + UI + infra fixes) should finally cut down duplicates. Ping here if anything blocks progress. :+1:
